blocks.label: Neutral Base Rate
blocks.instructions:
Contact Identification — NeutralIdentify each acoustic contact. Alpha and Bravo appear equally often (50/50).
  • Press 1 for Alpha, 0 for Bravo.
  • Correct: +10 pts. Incorrect: -10 pts.

blocks.label: Neutral Base Rate
blocks.instructions:
Contact Identification — NeutralIdentify each acoustic contact. Alpha and Bravo appear equally often (50/50).
  • Press 1 for Alpha, 0 for Bravo, then rate confidence with 1 / 2 / 9 / 0 (guess → certain).
  • Correct: +10 pts. Incorrect: -10 pts.

blocks.label: High Alpha Base Rate
blocks.instructions:
Contact Identification — High Alpha RateAlpha contacts now appear 80% of the time. Bravo only 20%.
  • Adjust your strategy — when uncertain, Alpha is more likely.
  • Press 1 for Alpha, 0 for Bravo, then 1 / 2 / 9 / 0 for confidence.

blocks.label: Asymmetric Payoff
blocks.instructions:
Contact Identification — Asymmetric CostAlpha and Bravo appear equally often (50/50).
  • Missing an Alpha costs -50 pts; a false Alpha report costs only -5 pts.
  • Lean toward Alpha when uncertain. Keys: 1=Alpha, 0=Bravo; confidence 1 / 2 / 9 / 0.

blocks.label: High Rate + Asymmetric Payoff
blocks.instructions:
Contact Identification — CombinedAlpha appears 80% of the time. Missing Alpha costs -50 pts; false alarm costs -5 pts.
  • Both base rate and payoff favor reporting Alpha when uncertain.
  • Keys: 1=Alpha, 0=Bravo; confidence 1 / 2 / 9 / 0.
